title: Apex Integration
description: A companion mod for the Apex Cobblemon server!
body:
![Server Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60d6b8b2297cb1475e200f80933ae97dfa4dae15.png)
### **Apex Cobblemon Integration** ![Discord Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1978d95df43c9cb2f01af72f1e8c9f43a00ed2de.png) [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/apexcobblemon)    ![Heart Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/653693cfbfef44fc41cbf349be719da9f33f2f03.png) [**Install Guide**](https://apexcobblemon.com/modpack)    ![Help](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0862cc275b6c3c7b907bc9264945c5b5b08663df.png) [**Wiki**](https://wiki.apexcobblemon.com)

This mod introduces a variety of features designed specifically for the Apex Cobblemon server, and is included in the [Official Apex Cobblemon Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/apex-cobblemon).
## Modpack Rewards Players using the latest version of the Official Apex Cobblemon Modpack receive several exclusive rewards and bonuses, which are granted automatically when the server detects that you are playing with the current official modpack. ![Modpack Rewards](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a71c7c38a5752b7cf8d7c3742ad1565bb1780c45.png)
## Emoji Suggestions Apex Integration automatically suggests any unlocked [Emojis](https://wiki.apexcobblemon.com/features/player/cosmetics#emojis) while typing in chat. When you begin typing an emoji code, a suggestion menu will appear above the chat box, allowing you to quickly select matching Emojis without needing to memorize every available code. ![Emoji Suggestions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d65f47aa2a6c850fcb3d5faa3b7d22bf0ce717cd.png)
## Cosmetic Previews Apex Integration allows you to preview wearable [cosmetics](https://wiki.apexcobblemon.com/features/player/cosmetics) directly from the `/cosmetics` menu. Hovering over wearable cosmetics will display a preview, making it easier to see how a cosmetic looks before equipping it. ![Cosmetic Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RTt7S27q/images/33fd3b58cc9bca0dd32d30eb4b9ddb1bdf1f7778.gif)
## Discord Presence Apex Integration can update your Discord status with your current activity on Apex Cobblemon. Depending on what you are doing in-game, your Discord Rich Presence may show activity such as: ![discord1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2d0d8579a384619f31e4bf6c59eebae57662425.png) ![discord2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1afe8542f76d77d66b90d35c30a15cc6798e36b.png) ![discord3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a048cd8d78602d21ee85305f33b16c759229c3f3.png)
This feature requires the following launcher settings to be adjusted: - **Modrinth:** Settings → Privacy → Disable Discord RPC - **CurseForge:** Settings → Privacy → Disable Discord Rich Presence
## Nameplates Apex Integration improves the vanilla Minecraft nameplate system with custom Apex Cobblemon nameplates. These enhanced nameplates allow the server to display additional player information above characters, including [Titles](https://wiki.apexcobblemon.com/features/player/cosmetics#titles), [Crown Level](https://wiki.apexcobblemon.com/features/player/badges/crown-ranks), [Style Level](https://wiki.apexcobblemon.com/features/player/cosmetics/style-ranks), and [Fishing Level](https://wiki.apexcobblemon.com/features/fishing/fishing-level). Modpack users can also view their own nameplate while in third-person mode, making it easier to see how their title, levels, and tags appear to other players. Only players using the official modpack can see the full enhanced nameplate display. ![Nameplates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47d0c427df37f37a7c85ca196c33ebd53b08555d.png)
## Channel Buttons Apex Integration adds clickable channel buttons next to the chat box, allowing you to switch chat channels without typing a command. Clicking a channel button instantly changes your active chat channel, making it easier to move between conversations while playing. ![Channel Buttons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4b4942224be36225e9c15557dbe6142d653af4c.png)
## PC Hotkey Apex Integration adds a dedicated hotkey for quickly opening your PC. By default, pressing **P** will open your PC from anywhere, allowing you to manage your Pokémon without needing to run a command or visit a PC block.
## Config Menu Apex Integration includes an in-game configuration menu powered through [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu). This menu allows you to adjust supported client-side settings directly in-game. Available options include visual preferences, quality-of-life settings, and other Apex Integration features. _Quickly access this menu with the shortcut button in the top left of the Minecraft Options menu._ ![Settings Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9c9e587600a9970aebd2839206a7f7f9b6a068e.png)
## Render Fixes Apex Integration includes several client-side render fixes designed to improve visual consistency.
FixDescription
Text Background TransparencyEnsures supported text backgrounds render with proper transparency instead of appearing fully opaque
Item Stack LabelsFixes cases where item stack labels, such as damage indicators, could render incorrectly over containers with font-image titles

## Resource Pack Updates Apex Integration automatically keeps supported resource packs up to date while using the Official Apex Cobblemon Modpack. When a new version of a resource pack is installed, the updated version is automatically enabled for you, so you do not need to manually adjust your resource pack list.
